note: Within the parent (Lin- CD14+; CD14+ already enforced upstream), the events form a dense vertical column on the right (CD11c+) with CD16 spanning low-to-high. CD14pos_CD16pos: CD14+ CD16+ monocytes — captured as the top sliver of this column above the CD16 peak (anchor on the dense CD16 peak inside the CD11c+ column; the boundary sits at the upper shoulder of that peak, and only events above this boundary are CD14pos_CD16pos). The bulk below (CD16-low to mid, including the CD16 peak itself) is excluded.
tips: Identify the CD16+ (non-classical / intermediate) monocyte subset within CD14+ monocytes. CD14pos_CD16pos: CD14+ CD16+ (encompasses both intermediate CD14++CD16+ and non-classical CD14+CD16++; refined 3-subset gating would require a CD14 vs CD16 quadrant that is not performed here). CD16-negative events (classical monocytes CD14++CD16-) are not explicitly labeled in this step. Axis design caveat: x_marker is CD11c, but CD11c is not used as a discriminator here — the CD16+ call is driven by CD16 on y; CD11c is shown as a display / sanity-check axis to confirm monocyte identity (monocytes are typically CD11c+, so events should cluster at CD11c-positive).
